#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODE="${1:-core}"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PACK_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
OUT="${2:-$PACK_ROOT/downloaded_official_docs}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"

python3 - "$PACK_ROOT/config/components.json" "$OUT" "$MODE" <<'PY'
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, pathlib
cfg, out, mode = sys.argv[1:]
components = json.load(open(cfg, encoding="utf-8"))
core = {"deepseek","mimo","coze","midscene","playwright","json-schema","ajv",
        "openapi","nodejs","typescript","eslint","ffmpeg","fineract","mifos"}
def safe(s): return re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.\-\u4e00-\u9fff]+','_',s)
for c in components:
    if mode.lower() == "core" and c["id"] not in core:
        continue
    d = pathlib.Path(out) / safe(c["category"]) / safe(c["name"])
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d/"component-metadata.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(c, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for i,u in enumerate(c["docs"],1):
        (d/f"docs_{i:02d}.url").write_text(f"[InternetShortcut]\nURL={u}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for repo in c["repos"]:
        name = safe(repo.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1])
        dest = d/f"repo_{name}"
        if not dest.exists():
            subprocess.run(["git","clone","--depth","1",repo,str(dest)], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["rm","-rf",str(dest/".git")], check=True)
    if c["npm"]:
        nd = d/"npm_packages"; nd.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for pkg in c["npm"]:
            subprocess.run(["npm","pack",pkg,"--pack-destination",str(nd)], check=True)
    for url in c["pdfs"]:
        target = d/(safe(url.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1])+".pdf")
        subprocess.run(["curl","-L","--fail","--retry","2","-o",str(target),url], check=True)
PY
